prescribedGeometry.description: Exact A1.2 prescribed display paths with zero axial half-separation, coincident endpoint orbit centers, equal radii, equal frequencies, and the declared 120-degree phase spacing.

choices: The flattening coordinate lambda_A=0.35 is illustrative.
Every binary midpoint is the braid origin in the relative frame; h_a=0 and rho_a=R=0.32 make each endpoint pair traverse one common geometric circle.
The common frequency f=0.25 and declared phase spacing are prescribed display choices.
Normalized linear axis interpolation is illustrative between the taxonomy-defined endpoints.
